spec: §15 suite C (the §16.3 examples as normative test vectors); §16.3 example 1 envelope and hash; §9.2 identity and object_hash
derivation: The §16.3 envelope bytes (3 prefix lines + the 6 canonical function lines, each LF-terminated) hash to 8ce5e64f... under SHA-256 (verified with an independent SHA-256 over the printed envelope, not the interpreter). With no other symbols the closure hash equals the interface hash. The object has no schedule/certificate/coverage section, so object_hash is the SHA-256 of the whole canonical text, 8093da48... (same independent computation).
